title: Stop & Call - Fraud detection ruleset
description: Local, on-device ruleset used by rules-engine to evaluate shared text (SMS/WhatsApp/email) and flag potential scam signals. No network calls; everything is processed on the device (see docs/PRIVACIDAD.md).

version.description: SemVer version of this ruleset file.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last update.

signals.description: How rules-engine detects this pattern. At least one of keywordGroups or regex must be present.

keywordGroups.description: Array of keyword groups. A group matches if ANY of its keywords is found (case-insensitive, accent-insensitive). The rule matches if the number of matching groups >= minGroupMatches.

minGroupMatches.description: Minimum number of keywordGroups that must match. Defaults to the total number of groups (i.e. all groups required) if omitted.

regex.description: Optional additional regex patterns (case-insensitive). If present alongside keywordGroups, ANY regex match OR the keyword-group condition triggers the rule.

userMessage.description: Plain-language message shown to the end user. Must follow docs/CONTRIBUTING.md tone checklist: short, second person, no jargon, ends with a concrete action.

source.description: Where this pattern comes from (e.g. 'INCIBE aviso marzo 2026', 'reporte de usuario').
